cases.question: 按SalesTerritory的Name统计Customer的CustomerID记录数
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name,COUNT(c.CustomerID) FROM Customer c JOIN SalesTerritory t ON c.TerritoryID=t.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.Name

cases.question: 按Customer的AccountNumber统计SalesOrderHeader的SubTotal合计
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.AccountNumber,SUM(h.SubTotal) FROM SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Customer c ON h.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.AccountNumber

cases.question: 按Customer的AccountNumber统计SalesOrderHeader的SalesOrderID记录数
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.AccountNumber,COUNT(h.SalesOrderID) FROM SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Customer c ON h.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.AccountNumber

cases.question: 按SalesTerritory的Name统计2023年SalesOrderHeader的OrderDate对应SubTotal合计
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name,SUM(h.SubTotal) FROM SalesOrderHeader h JOIN SalesTerritory t ON h.TerritoryID=t.TerritoryID WHERE h.OrderDate>='2023-01-01' AND h.OrderDate<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY t.Name

cases.question: SalesTerritory的CountryRegionCode为US的Customer的CustomerID记录数是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(c.CustomerID) FROM Customer c JOIN SalesTerritory t ON c.TerritoryID=t.TerritoryID WHERE t.CountryRegionCode='US'

cases.question: 按Customer的AccountNumber统计SalesOrderHeader的TotalDue合计，取最高前三名含并列
cases.gold_sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT c.AccountNumber,SUM(h.TotalDue) v FROM SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Customer c ON h.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.AccountNumber), ranked AS (SELECT AccountNumber,v,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY v DESC) r FROM totals) SELECT AccountNumber,v FROM ranked WHERE r<=3
